newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore and China's Shandong start air link.
newsitem.headline: Singapore and China's Shandong start air link.

text.p: Singapore and the Chinese city of Qingdao in northeastern Shandong province established direct air links on Thursday, the Trade Development Board (TDB) said on Friday.
It said in a statement the inaugural flight between the two cities brought a 16-member trade delegation from Shandong for an official visit between June 26 and 30.
The route is the only air link between Singapore and Shandong and the third international route established by Qingdao after Japan and Korea, it said.
The TDB said the link would improve communication between Singapore and Shandong and add to commercial and tourism cooperation between the two areas.
The Singapore secretariat of the Singapore-Shandong Business Council set up an office in the capital, Jinan, in October.
